title: Operator-Local Execution Clearance Mechanism Design
summary: Record the design for an operator-local execution clearance mechanism after FP-MCP-217 decided that execution clearance must remain outside the model-callable MCP surface. Current source inspection found the global disable switch is hard-coded active and no local clearance mechanism exists yet. This packet chooses a three-layer direction: design a human-created local clearance artifact, then implement MCP read-only observation/validation of that artifact, and only later wire guarded execution to require the validated local clearance state.
caveats: This is a design packet only; no MCP bridge code is modified.
No local clearance artifact is created by this packet.
No MCP tool to create or clear execution state is approved.
The current disable switch remains hard-coded active until a later implementation changes the status policy to observe a local operator-created clearance artifact.
The fresh FP-MCP-216 approval is time-boxed and may expire before any future implementation is ready; it must be freshly validated or renewed before consumption.
This packet does not consume approval, contact the runner start endpoint, start OpenCode, or run FP-027.

observedProblem.currentDisableSwitchImplementation: src/server.ts getExecutionDisableSwitchStatus hard-codes globalDisableActive = true and returns disableSwitchActive: true, executionAllowedNow: false.
observedProblem.consequence: The FP-MCP-217 architecture is correct, but there is currently no hands-on-keyboard local clearance mechanism for the operator to use.

layeredPlan.layer1DesignPacket: FP-MCP-219 records the operator-local clearance design before implementation.
layeredPlan.layer2ClearanceArtifactDesign: Define a local, gitignored, human-created, time-boxed, scoped clearance artifact.
layeredPlan.layer3ObserverFirstImplementation: Implement only read-only MCP observation/validation of the local artifact before any execution policy wiring or guarded start attempt.

selectedMechanism.creator: human operator outside MCP/model-callable tool surface
mcpMustNot: consume approval in the same action as observing clearance
contact runner start endpoint in the same action as observing clearance

validationRules: artifact path must be local-only and outside tracked evidence/packet directories
clearanceId must use a controlled CLEARANCE timestamp/id format
expiresAt must be in the future and within a short maximum lifetime
operatorStatement must explicitly authorize one guarded attempt only
executionPacketId/requestId/approvalId/modelId/runMode/targetWorkspaceId/branch/targetExecutionCommit must match the validated request and approval tuple
current repository branch and commit must match the artifact scope or fail closed
approval must still be valid and unconsumed at the time of validation
no standing or wildcard scope is allowed
stale, missing, malformed, broad, expired, or mismatched clearance fails closed

futureReadOnlyToolCandidate.name: forgepilot_get_operator_local_execution_clearance_status
allowedBehavior: read the single local clearance artifact path
compare artifact scope to request/approval/current repo state

futureExecutionPolicyDirection.principle: guarded start may only proceed if local clearance observer reports an exact, fresh, single-use, scoped clearance that matches current request/approval/repo state
futureExecutionPolicyDirection.separation: clearance observation, approval consumption, and runner start remain separate actions
